READ	select from_csv('1, 3.14', 'a INT, f FLOAT')
READ	select from_csv('26/08/2015', 'time Timestamp', map('timestampFormat', 'dd/MM/yyyy'))
READ	select from_csv('1', 1)
READ	select from_csv('1', 'a InvalidType')
READ	select from_csv('1', 'Array<int>')
READ	select from_csv('1', 'a INT', named_struct('mode', 'PERMISSIVE'))
READ	select from_csv('1', 'a INT', map('mode', 1))
READ	select from_csv()
READ	select from_csv('1,abc', schema_of_csv('1,abc'))
READ	select schema_of_csv('1|abc', map('delimiter', '|'))
READ	select schema_of_csv(null)
READ	select schema_of_csv(42)
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW csvTable(csvField, a) AS SELECT * FROM VALUES ('1,abc', 'a')
READ	SELECT schema_of_csv(csvField) FROM csvTable
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS csvTable
READ	select to_csv(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2))
READ	select to_csv(named_struct('time', to_timestamp('2015-08-26', 'yyyy-MM-dd')), map('timestampFormat', 'dd/MM/yyyy'))
READ	select to_csv(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2), named_struct('mode', 'PERMISSIVE'))
READ	select to_csv(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2), map('mode', 1))
READ	select from_csv('14:30:45', 'time TIME(0)')
READ	select from_csv('14:30:45.123', 'time TIME(3)')
READ	select from_csv('14:30:45.123456', 'time TIME(6)')
READ	select from_csv('14-30-45.123456', 'time TIME(6)', map('timeFormat', 'HH-mm-ss.SSSSSS'))
READ	select to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45'))
READ	select to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45.123456'))
READ	select to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45.123456'), map('timeFormat', 'HH-mm-ss.SSSSSS'))
READ	select from_csv(to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45')), 'time TIME(0)')
READ	select from_csv(to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45.1')), 'time TIME(1)')
READ	select from_csv(to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45.12')), 'time TIME(2)')
READ	select from_csv(to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45.123')), 'time TIME(3)')
READ	select from_csv(to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45.1234')), 'time TIME(4)')
READ	select from_csv(to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45.12345')), 'time TIME(5)')
READ	select from_csv(to_csv(named_struct('time', TIME'14:30:45.123456')), 'time TIME(6)')
READ	select from_csv('25:00:00', 'time TIME')
READ	select from_csv('invalid', 'time TIME')
READ	select from_csv('', 'time TIME')
READ	select from_csv(null, 'time TIME')
READ	select schema_of_csv('14:30:45')
READ	select schema_of_csv('14:30:45.123456')
